# Lumela 0.2.2: Linux support for Ubuntu 22.04 and other older distributions

Lumela on Linux now runs on Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 and other distributions with glibc 2.35 or newer. Until now the Linux build needed glibc 2.39, so on those systems the app quit right after starting.

## What changed

- **The Linux AppImage and .deb are built on Ubuntu 22.04.** A Linux program can only run on systems whose C library is at least as new as the one it was built with; building on the oldest supported Ubuntu LTS lets Lumela run on many more distributions.
- **Every change is checked on Ubuntu 22.04 too.** CI now builds and tests Lumela on both Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04, so this stays fixed.

Windows and macOS are unchanged.

## Download

| Your system | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Lumela_0.2.2_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `Lumela_0.2.2_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Lumela_0.2.2_universal.dmg` |
| **Linux** (x64): Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 36+ or similar | `Lumela_0.2.2_amd64.AppImage` or `Lumela_0.2.2_amd64.deb` |

Already using Lumela? It updates itself. You can also install with Homebrew (`brew trust tw4/tap && brew install --cask tw4/tap/lumela`) or Scoop.

## New to Lumela?

Lumela is a free, open-source screenshot tool for Windows, macOS and Linux, in the spirit of CleanShot.

- **Looks good straight away.** Every capture gets a matching background, balanced padding, rounded corners and a soft shadow. Or none of it, with one click.
- **Explain without typing.** Arrows, text, shapes and numbered steps (1, 2, 3, in the order you click).
- **Private by default.** Emails, card numbers, IP addresses, API keys and your own private words are blurred automatically, on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
- **Copy text from any screenshot.** Select it like in a document.
- **Free, all of it.** No account, no subscription, no watermark.

## Help shape the next release

- If something in Lumela gets in your way, [open an issue](https://github.com/tw4/lumela/issues/new/choose).
- If Lumela saves you time, a ⭐ on GitHub helps other people find it.
- Lumela speaks English and Turkish. [Adding your language](https://github.com/tw4/lumela/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#translations) takes one file.
